main_text.p: דמא Ch. & Syr. Similem esse, Assimilari: Item Cogitare, putare, existimare, 1. Reg.8. 27. Ithpeh. Ch. אדמי Idem: & ad formam Syram Imper. אתדמא Assimilare, Prov.6.6. Ithpahel Ch. אדמי, Syr. ידמא Similis fieri, Assimilari. Vide quoque in דמא. Pahel דמי Ch. & Syr. Imaginari, cogitare, proponere sibi cogitando: Item Assimilare, comparare. Aphel אדמי Idem.
דמותא, דמות, דמו Ch. Syr. Similitudo, species, figura, forma, idea, imago, exemplar. Plural. Syr. כפלא ידמון Omnibus formis, ad Hebraeos 1.1. emphat. ידמון Similitudines, imagines, Act.7.43.
דמו Ch. Idem, Exod. 2.4. in Jonath.
דמאין Ch. Idola, imagines, simulachra, Judic.17.5. & 18.14. Hebr. תרפים.
דמך Ch. & Syr. Dormire, dormitare, obdormire: & metaphorice Mori. Pahel דמך Idem.
דמוך, דמיך Ch. & Syr. Somnolentus, somno gravatus, dormituriens: Deinde דמוך substantiv. Dormitio, Cantic.5. 2. בית דמוך Locus dormitionis, Cubile, ut Esth.1. 9.
דמכא Ch. Idem. Psal.127.3. Item Cubile. Plur. cum aff. על דמכיהון In cubilibus suis, Psal.149.v.5.

page.notes: Hebrew, Aramaic and Syriac words are rendered as closely as the scan allows; the vocalised forms, especially at the line ends and in the final entry, are doubtful. The last line of Hebrew letters below the text is uncertain.
